MEMB.description: Member Assignment (MEMB). Groups a set of connected elements into a single design/rating member; the member key drives which contiguous element chain is treated as one member, and the assigned elements must form a connected line not already claimed by another member.

AELEM.description: Element numbers that make up this member. The elements must be mutually connected (form a single continuous member); a single-element member is allowed. Assigning elements already belonging to another member is rejected.

bREVERSE.description: Reverse the member local direction relative to the natural element ordering. Default false.
